data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to fish this lake, and I want it to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in it now, we can each catch 10 tons this month and leave 50 to reproduce back to 100. That’s $10,000 each, with the same opportunity next month if we all stick to it. Can we agree to that limit and check the stock and everyone’s catches together each month? John, what do you think?
